active_plan_point.subarea: D-03 authored media Inspector and public renderer parity

scope.verified_slice: Authored video muted-autoplay and controls-free lifecycle through the real Editor Inspector, Save, reload, separate Publish, and public playback.

behavior: The actual Inspector permits controls=false for video only when autoplay=true and muted=true.
The Editor Canvas remains muted and controls-free but suppresses autoplay while editing.
Save persists the exact authored settings and media IDs to the draft; it does not make the video or poster public.
Editor reload restores the autoplay, muted, controls, source, and poster state.
Only the separate Publish grants public routes and renders autoplay=true, muted=true, controls=false.
The published video enters playback automatically in Chromium; its source and image poster bytes/MIME are checked against isolated D1/R2 fixtures.
The media usage API reports the poster as draft-only before Publish and published after Publish.

reuse_review.used: Existing SANCI authored-content Inspector, Page Model, Worker upload/publication routes, Miniflare D1/R2 fixtures, Playwright, and native HTMLVideoElement muted-autoplay behavior.
reuse_review.license_or_dependency_change: No external source copied and no dependency added; existing project-owned implementation and test stack reused.

browser_integration.environment: Local Worker + synthetic Miniflare D1/R2 + Chromium. The test bound only to loopback; the default restricted sandbox returned listen EPERM, so the verified pass used a loopback-capable sandbox. No production service was contacted by the test.
